effects.name: Inert
effects.text: You have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} and {ref:condition/prone} conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain {ref:condition/prone}.

effects.name: Saving Throws Affected
effects.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

effects.name: Automatic Critical Hits
effects.text: Any attack roll that hits you is a {ref:glossary/critical-hit} if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
